description.narrative: The Project consists of the following parts: (a) Mobilizing Creative Communities: Provision of support for the development of nationalcomma provincialcomma districtcomma and sub-district planning guidelines that provide practical guidance for including cultural dimension into the KDP planning process. (b) Capacity Development in Using Cultural Creativity to Reduce Poverty: Provision of training and mentoring support in the form of packages of capacity building facilities to poor communities to assist them in managing their cultural activities and marketing their skills. (c) Creative Communities Fund: Provision of block grants to local communitiescomma based on a set of clearly-defined conditionscomma to be used for village planning and community empowermentcomma and to promote engagement of the very poor with community leaderships through the use of arts and cultural activities. (d) Promoting the Engagement of Marginal Groups: Provision of block grants to be awarded by provincial and district committeescomma and administered through an NGO to be selected to execute the subprojectcomma to respond to the specific needs of an areas through funding of local artists and organization to work with poor regions to overcome socio-cultural problems that perpetuate poverty. (e) Monitoring the Participation of the Poorest Groups: Conducting an assessment of improvements in intra-village poverty targetingcomma gained as a result of this grant. (f) Strengthening Grass-roots Organizations/CCF Committees on Program Management: Provision of resources to fund the management costs of the Yayasan Kelola and honoraria for the provincialcomma district and sub-district Creative Committees involved at the grass-roots levels with communities. g) Documentation of Best Practices and Lessons Learned: production of a video documentary in Indonesian and English languages to feature the implementation process and lessons learned from the program
